reason: The hypothesis makes specific mechanistic claims about TiC-dislocation interactions, stress redistribution, and resulting property enhancements in a novel HEA, but cites no prior evidence to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the behavior of TiC dispersions in this specific equimolar WTaTiVZr matrix under the stated conditions.
premises: TiC particles act as barriers to dislocation motion at high temperature in the WTaTiVZr HEA matrix
TiC dispersion leads to stress redistribution and activation of secondary slip systems
Delayed crack initiation and propagation results from TiC-dislocation interactions
This mechanism enhances plastic strain and toughness relative to pure tungsten under PFC-relevant conditions
